content.short: No matter what colors, species, or wings a Skymon is assigned to, they are all equal.
content.description: 10,000 Skymon are unique on Cardano blockchain. Skymon is the first live NFT in the metaverse. They are created each with its unique traits. NFTs change how people can collect and trade assets, but we believe they can do more. Skymon are like your digital partners. They can accompany you on many adventures and create memorable achievements together in the metaverse. Skymon Center is a place for Skymon to rest, where they can find new owners, obtain some special items, and even create new species...?!
